The Oakhaven Project

Based on "Our Town"

Welcome, Traveler.

How to Play

Objective: Survive the passage of time without losing your Vitality.

The Guide: He watches every move. If you choose a "boring" path or ignore a detail, you lose half a heart.

Victory: Reach the end with your eyes open to the world.

Credits

Inspired by Thornton Wilder's "Our Town"

Made by Arnav K. Srivastava(8th Grader as of 2026)
